# Dell Belgium Alienware 16 Area-51 2026 — SRC-0279

## Sources

- https://www.dell.com/fr-be/shop/gaming-and-games/ordinateur-portable-gaming-alienware-16-area-51/spd/alienware-area-51-aa16250-gaming-laptop/aa16250_cto5?view=configurations
- https://www.dell.com/support/manuals/en-uk/alienware-area-51-aa16250-gaming-laptop/alienware-16-area-51-aa16250-owners-manual/gpudiscrete

## Evidence

Dell Belgium lists the current refreshed `aa16250_cto5` at €4348.79 including VAT with Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus, RTX 5080 16GB, 32GB as 2x16GB, 1TB, 16-inch 240Hz OLED and a French keyboard. The display is listed as anti-reflective, 120% DCI-P3 volume and 620 HDR nits. The configuration includes only 12 months Alienware Care onsite. The chassis provides two Thunderbolt 5 ports for RTX 5070 Ti and above, three USB-A, HDMI and SD, but no integrated Ethernet; Dell bundles a USB-C-to-2.5GbE dongle with the 360W adapter. This fails the buyer's mandatory integrated-RJ45 gate and leaves only €95.38 below the Dell reference before extending service.
